With a clack of its razor-sharp beak, the sacrissian weaves around tree trunks in pursuit of its favored prey, frondilli, chasing the spry 
deer into an open grove. Th e nimble mammal is no match for the lithe reptile as it closes the distance and slams its horned crest into 
the fleeing prey, launching it to crash into a tree, broken. Th ere are few places in Sol’Kesh free from the terror of a sacrissian, stalking 
across the Farplains with impunity, gracefully swimming through both fresh and salt water, and in the colder seasons, wintering in the 
caverns of the Umbrawells. With a widely dispersed hunting range, its rare to see two within miles of each other as their beaked cries 
warn others of their kind to keep their distance, lest they are ready to challenge for territory, or to mate.

Encountering Often hunting alone, they only ever congregate 
beneath the safety of the Wealdwoods during the late spring 
mating season. Several will share communal nests in the hollows 
of trees or shallow caves, defending their clutch together before 
parting to their own hunting grounds. Th ese reptiles see most 
creatures, including their own, as either prey or challengers and 
respond aggressively to any that get to near.
Skills Athletics +8, Perception +5, Stealth +7
Indiscriminate Hunter Th e sacrissian has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on smell and hearing.
Aggressive Challenger While in combat, the sacrissian has 
Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn’t yet had 
a turn to act in combat.
Nimble Hunter Whenever the sacrissian successfully attacks a 
creature, it may Dash as a Bonus Action. Th e sacrissian doesn’t 
provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy’s 
reach.
